title: Constraint-Violation Outcome Benchmark for Long-Horizon Tasks

original_idea.body: # Constraint-Violation Outcome Benchmark for Long-Horizon Tasks

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Strong chain: constraint-following is the checkable core of safe autonomy; outcome-driven violations are concrete.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Accessible: tasks with explicit constraints + automatic checker, no human grading.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Tightly scoped: 25-30 tasks, constraint-violation rate vs length, automatic checker.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Independent-friendly: open/API agents, automatic checks, reusable benchmark.

novelty.reasoning: A 2025 benchmark already evaluates outcome-driven constraint violations.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: An outcome-driven constraint-violation benchmark already exists (arXiv 2512.20798).
